description: This PHP source file defines the StreamHandler class within the OrangeHRM project. The class extends Monolog's StreamHandler to add a conditional check for log file writability based on the application's service container context.

classes.name: StreamHandler
classes.description: A custom log stream handler that conditionally writes log records based on the container and HTTP kernel's log file writability status.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Overrides the parent write method to only proceed if the log file is writable, as determined by the HTTP kernel service in the container.
